_meta.title: FF Driving Video
_meta.note: The source clip: BOTH the performance to copy AND the real plate to preserve. Feeds background_video directly and pose_video via DWPreprocessor below — unlike WanAnimate2ToVideo, this node's whole point is that the frame is NOT regenerated from scratch.

_meta.title: FF Video Components
_meta.note: Splits the driving video into frames / audio / fps. fps (output 2) and audio (output 1) are link-wired straight into FF Create Video, so keep_original_audio is a plain passthrough — no audio model involved, since the background (and its original audio) is preserved, not regenerated.

_meta.title: FF Character Ref
_meta.note: The new character's identity: one still. Feeds both reference_image and the CLIP-vision encode.

_meta.title: FF UNet
_meta.note: Wan2.2-Animate V1 (Mix/Replace mode) int8. NOT the same repo as wan_animate_2_* (that's the V2/no-mask sequel) — this is Comfy-Org/Wan_2.2_ComfyUI_Repackaged's wan2.2_animate_14B_int8_convrot.safetensors. No baked-in distilled variant exists for this model; the shared lightx2v_I2V_14B_480p_cfg_step_distill_rank64_bf16.safetensors LoRA is the acceleration path (NOT wired here yet — first pass uses the full base recipe for correctness, optimize to the LoRA once this is proven).

_meta.title: FF Positive
_meta.note: Patched per request. Describes the new character's appearance/wardrobe; motion and background come from the driving video, not from here.

inputs.text: 色调艳丽, 过曝, 静态, 细节模糊不清, blurry, low quality, distorted face, extra limbs, watermark, text

_meta.title: FF Pose Estimate
_meta.note: comfyui_controlnet_aux's DWPose Estimator (class DWPreprocessor). Derives pose_video from the driving video's own frames — this is the piece WanAnimate2ToVideo's simpler graph never needed, since V2 has no Mix mode to drive.

_meta.title: FF Mask Video
_meta.note: Subject mask matching the driving video, frame-for-frame. First test: supply this from the MATTE lane's own output (BiRefNet+MatAnyone2, already proven) rather than standing up a second DWPose-derived masking path.

_meta.title: FF Mask Convert
_meta.note: Same conversion vace_inpaint.json uses for its own control mask (white=subject here, matching MATTE's alpha convention).

_meta.title: FF Replace
_meta.note: WanAnimateToVideo (V1) — real Mix/Replace mode: background_video + character_mask means the masked region is composited onto the REAL plate, not regenerated. This is the node WAN-ANIMATE's WanAnimate2ToVideo does not have. face_video left unconnected for this first pass (optional per object_info; add if identity/expression fidelity needs it).

_meta.title: FF Sampler
_meta.note: UNOPTIMIZED FIRST PASS: base (non-distilled) recipe — 40 steps, cfg 5.0 — chosen for correctness over speed since there is no baked distilled checkpoint for V1 (unlike V2's wan_animate_2_distill_*). Tune steps/cfg and/or wire the lightx2v distill LoRA once the graph is proven end-to-end. seed patched per request.

_meta.title: FF Create Video
_meta.note: fps and audio come from the DRIVING video's own components — keep_original_audio is this passthrough; force_new_voice (not built yet) would replace input 'audio' with a voice-clone/TTS pass instead.
